response.original_title: Wolfoo và hòn đảo kỳ bí
response.overview: Wolfoo and The Mysterious Island - the story about the main character, 8-year-old little wolf Wolfoo - a cheerful, kind-hearted boy who loves to explore. Accompanying Wolfoo is her mischievous 6-year-old sister Lucy, who often acts spoiled but loves her brother a lot. The story begins when Wolfoo and Lucy are sucked into a necklace and come to the Spirit World - an extremely magical world. At Spirit World, an unexpected incident happened and separated two brothers. In the journey to find his sister, Wolfoo was accidentally caught up in a fierce battle against the army of demons - led by Demon Lord Bane - ruling Mystic Island. Not only about an adventure story, the film also carries valuable lessons about creativity, courage and love. All of that has created a movie that satisfies audience's entertainment but is also full of education.
response.title: Wolfoo and the Mysterious Island
